mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market, which reduces household wealth and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption (RSAFS) falls below 700,000 million dollars in a month, it signals a sharp drop in consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is below 700000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a severe labor market contraction, reducing disposable income and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four months signals a recessionary economy, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
